answer.explanation: The visible window shows no errors, timeouts, throttling or memory exhaustion. Max memory used stays well below the configured size for every function (e.g. Compression 97-118 MB of 1024 MB, Uploader 96 MB of 256 MB, CrudApi 90 MB of 128 MB). Durations are steady and consistent per function. The CrudApi cold starts (Init Duration around 390-490 ms) are ordinary concurrent initialisation. About 4,300 events were truncated, so this conclusion covers only the visible portion of the window.
